ceilingSources.residentMemoryBytes: rule: 2x the larger measured resident set (49430528 B over the recorded hosts), rounded up to a whole MiB; evidence runtime-budget.evidence/
ceilingSources.idleCpuPercent: rule: 1 percent absolute for an idle crate; measured at most 0.052 percent on the recorded hosts
ceilingSources.wakeupsPerSecond: rule: max(1, 2x measured) per second; macOS measured 0.033; Windows exposes no wake-up counter
ceilingSources.diskOpsPerSecond: rule: max(1, 2x measured) per second; Windows measured 0.0 (GetProcessIoCounters, all I/O including pipes); macOS exposes no per-process disk-operation counter

status.note: The status call returns rightkit_process::ProcessUsage (resident and footprint bytes, cumulative CPU seconds, wake-up and disk-operation totals where the host reports them) beside the crate's own queue figures; the rates come from two calls (ProcessUsage::rates_since). Wake-ups are macOS only; disk operations are Windows and Linux only.

notes: Ceilings come from the recorded measurements by stated rules (ceilingSources); a ceiling left null names its reason below.
